[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | ingame name=The Mirror of Lyss | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=419 }} [[The Mirror of Lyss]] refers to the large and beautiful lake and plaza in the center of this area, surrounding the primary site of the worship of [[Lyssa]] in [[Vabbi]], the [[Sebelkeh Basilica]]. The central lake that is fed by two waterfalls is considered the start of the [[Elon]] river. It is one of the most connected locations in Vabbi, leading to the areas ruled by each of the three [[Prince of Vabbi|Princes of Vabbi]]. ==Getting there== Characters will arrive in this area for the first time as part of the [[primary quest]] [[All's Well That Ends Well]]. Several other follow-up primary quests, as well as quite a few [[secondary quest]]s, will give reason for characters to revisit this area. ==Exits== *[[Dasha Vestibule (outpost)|Dasha Vestibule]]
